channel.title: The Record by Recorded Future
channel.description: Trimmed fixture (2026-11-24): selected items, excerpts of at most 280 characters, names redacted, no author names.

item.title: Carnegie Endowment for International [named person] says third-party breach leaked donation info
item.description: Some donors to the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace had their information leaked due to a cyberattack on a third-party vendor named Soapbox Engage.

item.title: UK cyber agency seeing ‘marked rise’ in AI-driven attacks
item.description: Britain’s National Cyber Security Centre said it has observed “a marked rise” since September in cyberattacks assisted by artificial intelligence and warned the technology was increasing attackers’ speed, scale and persistence.

item.title: McDonald’s Japan discloses breach exposing customer purchase and location data
item.description: McDonald’s Japan disclosed a cybersecurity breach that exposed customers’ purchase histories and mobile device location data.
